name: Oakley Data Center Moratorium
additional_info: Oakley City Council voted unanimously to impose 45-day moratorium blocking city from accepting, processing, or approving any land use applications tied to data centers. First Bay Area city to take such action (May 2026). Triggered by concerns about energy demand, water use, and community impacts from AI-era data centers.

additional_info: A 275MW data center development on the Elk Hills Oil Field, utilizing CRC's existing Elk Hills Power Plant with grid connections as backup.

name: Rucci AI Data Center - Imperial County (Aten & Clark Rd)
additional_info: Controversial $10B, 330 MW AI DC on 74 acres. Avoiding CA enviro review. City of Imperial suing county. 750,000 gal/day water need. Nov 2026 ballot initiative pending. Nearly 1M sqft computing warehouse. $10B investment. Serving one major tech company (unnamed). Electricity demand could equal all of Imperial County's 2024 consumption. 750,000 gallons water/day. City of Imperial filed lawsuit Dec 2025 alleging inadequate environmental review. Developer seeking to bypass CEQA. Originally proposed within city limits; relocated to county land after initial opposition. Residents organizing November 2026 ballot initiative: "Imperial County Data Center Prohibition Act." El Centro issued conditional water service letter October 2025 (not a final agreement). Imperial has not committed to water agreement. Developer's business history in Ohio includes criminal investigations. [Stage updated 2026-08-31: Imperial County stated that Superior Court ordered the County to set aside its data center moratorium; the project-specific developer was the plaintiff in the case, removing the countywide approval hold, though broader policy review continues.] [Stage updated 2026-09-07: Imperial County Superior Court tentatively ordered the County to set aside key approvals and prepare a full environmental impact report before processing permits for the proposed 330 MW project.]

name: DataBank and Goodman Group Los Angeles Data Center
additional_info: DataBank and Goodman Group have announced a joint venture to develop a 32MW data center in Vernon, Los Angeles, to meet growing demand from cloud, AI, and enterprise customers. A new 32MW data center facility located at 3094 E Vernon Avenue in Vernon, CA, aimed at meeting the growing demand for high-density, scalable data center capacity in the Los Angeles region. Joint venture between DataBank and Goodman Group. 32 MW facility targeting one of the most supply-constrained data center markets in the US. Vernon announced it will tap remaining available power for additional capacity. Development to begin 2026 per JLL report. [Stage updated 2026-08-17: Construction has commenced on the 32MW data center facility in Vernon, CA, with the first 6MW phase expected to launch in December 2026.]

name: RB Inyokern Data Center
additional_info: Proposed 99 MW hyperscale cloud and AI data center on approximately 50 acres. The California Energy Commission began CEQA EIR review on November 5, 2026 for the associated small power plant exemption application. The project includes a customer-owned 115/34.5 kV substation, six modular data halls, and 40 emergency diesel generators serving up to 99 MW of backup load. California Energy Commission began the EIR process on November 5 for the Small Power Plant Exemption application. The proposed facility has approximately 70 MW of IT load and 99 MW total electrical demand, with 40 diesel backup generators, hybrid cooling, and a new customer-dedicated substation.
address: Northwest quadrant of State Route 178 (West Inyokern Road) and U.S. Highway 395, Inyokern, Kern County, CA
